scope: Native 3D gpu_narrow_phase_shape_shape_deferred including mixed convex tags, mesh triangles, thick polyline segments, reversed pair frames and strided lanes
tolerance_reason: Work-list identities, shape words, thickness copies, sort keys, counts, guards and provenance are exact. Work-list pose/extent arithmetic uses 2e-6/2e-5. Atomic emission order may differ, including a legal unique subset on overflow; the requested total stays exact. Manifold numeric policy matches pfm_manifold, including bounded valid nonunique witnesses and reflected symmetry, with inactive post-dedup point payload excluded. Reduction only selects/copies native values and remains bit exact.
preconditions: Valid finite native collider geometry and normalized poses; global collider/body identity maps and finite materials
Composite BVHs have in-range acyclic entry/exit links, unique leaf subshape identities and valid primitive/index/vertex ranges
Counters fit u32; capacity-clamped positional contact storage is twice pair capacity; caller resizes and reruns on overflow before full simulation use
PFM order is a permutation of the clamped prefix; reduction keys are sorted with one collider frame per run
PfmCandidates is a live native diagnostic superset for validation only; no generated kernel reads it
invariants: Exact requested work-list totals, legal membership, unique ownership and untouched capacity tails
Same-body PFM contacts write only an inert length; live contacts preserve collider/body/subshape/material provenance
Every valid contact has a unit normal, in-shape primary point and independent support/prediction bounds; secondary reference misses remain visible
Reduction preserves disjoint run ownership and selects only supplied candidate points
No host collision computation inside any translated stage
outside_scope: Composition with resident radix sorting, overflow resize/retry and production scene stepping
Composite-composite contact generation, which the native PFM dispatcher does not support
Triangle-mesh point projection/pseudo-normal queries and full scene stability qualification
Ascend vendor compilation, execution, memory-model qualification and performance
